facts.fact: No: pmkisan-gov.in is not the official PM-KISAN website; it is not a .gov.in domain, and the .gov.in zone is reserved for government departments
facts.quote: the domain zone .gov.In will be exclusively reserved for registering domain names under government Departments.
facts.note: Derived: pmkisan-gov.in ends in .in, not .gov.in, so it is not a government domain; no official page names pmkisan-gov.in itself.

facts.fact: The official PM-KISAN website is pmkisan.gov.in
facts.quote: An exclusive web-portal www.pmkisan.gov.in has been launched for the Scheme.

facts.fact: pmkisan.gov.in is managed by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and hosted by NIC
facts.quote: Site is designed and hosted by National Informatics Centre. Contents published and managed by Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.

summary: pmkisan.gov.in confirmed as the official portal (PIB; site footer); pmkisan-gov.in is not a .gov.in domain (MeitY domain policy, derived).
